lines: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, IST-DAS 2.00 bpw: a 257 GB download (138 GB of model, 111 GB n-gram table, 8 GB drafter). Quality: about 15.5% above the original model's perplexity (code and agent work about 5-9% above).

The n-gram table stays on the SSD and is read a few rows for each word: use an NVMe drive for the model files (a slow disk makes every word slower). The same table serves every IST-DAS set, so installing another one downloads it once.

Graphics memory: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 (24 GB). About 2,339 of the 15,360 experts (20 GB) stay on the card; the other 13,021 (112 GB) are computed on the CPU from RAM, and the ones RAM cannot hold are read from the SSD when a word needs them.

This computer has 64 GB of RAM: Strata keeps the experts you use most in RAM (it sizes this itself) and reads the rest from the SSD. Measured: about 4.7 tokens a second on 64 GB of RAM and a 12 GB card, about 7 on 46 GB with a faster drive. More RAM or a faster NVMe drive makes it quicker.

Measured on an RTX 5070 (12 GB) with 64 GB of RAM and a 3.6 GB/s NVMe drive: answers about 4.7 tokens a second, a 4,000-token prompt read at 121 tokens a second; an RTX 3060 (12 GB) with 46 GB of RAM: about 7.2 tokens a second; four Radeon AI PRO R9700 cards: about 31 tokens a second. Other computers are slower or faster by what their cards, RAM and drive can do.
